messages:
maria: quick ask  can we add a 'canary cost preview' so teams understand cache warmup impact? many folks think canaries are overpriced.

jake: agree. show measured vs projected steady-state cost, with a small uncertainty band. keeps support noise down.

sarah: billing rule: projections must be advisory only. invoices = measured tokens. add explicit copy.

tom: telemetry: we emit cache_hit flag and model_sku per invocation, but we need a route+sku hit-rate time series. low-cost agg job should do it.

maria: UX: toggle [Measured | Projected | Both] and list assumptions (sample rate, avg seq len). default Both.

jake: projection algorithm proposal: sliding-window hit% extrapolated to steady state, SKU-aware. show per-SKU lines if variants used.

sarah: please surface sample rate and confidence tooltip. wording: "Projection assumes stable request mix; billed cost is measured."

ops-bot: feature-flag created ff/canary-cost-preview-2026. owner: @maria.

maria: plan: I'll prototype UI with stubbed endpoint and pair with @tom to size precompute work. will tag @jake for pricing calc.

ops-bot: deploy-notice: ff scheduled to staging 2026-03-10 02:00 UTC.
